examples.summary: This page defines relief groove standards for grinding zones (TAB-001) and thread terminations (TAB-002). Grinding relief grooves follow UNI4386 with dimensions scaled by shaft diameter (18mm to >125mm), featuring widths from 2.5-7mm and radii from R1.6 to R4.0. Thread relief grooves are required where threads meet shoulders, with 60° angle and dimensions proportional to thread pitch (P). All groove geometry must be detailed in drawings per Bonfiglioli/TRASMITAL specifications.

examples.summary: This page defines standard relief groove specifications for grinding zones and threaded features per Bonfiglioli standards TAB-001 and TAB-002. Grinding relief grooves follow UNI4386 with TRASMITAL modifications, scaling in size (2.5-7mm width, 0.4-1.3mm depth) across four diameter ranges (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm). Thread relief grooves are mandatory where threads meet shoulders, with dimensions varying by thread pitch from P≤1.25 to P=2.5-3, requiring radii from R1.2 to R2.0 and widths from 3.3mm to 5.0mm.

All grinding grooves use 30° angles with specific widths, depths, and radii. The standards reference both UNI regulation (dashed lines) and TRASMITAL specifications (solid lines), with requirements to detail specific grooves on drawings.
